name: harmonyos-feature-implementation
title: HarmonyOS Feature Implementation
job_to_be_done: Implement and verify HarmonyOS NEXT pages from frozen Android page contracts and an approved scaffold, using a per-page UI understanding and conversion agent, page-owned work orders, shared capability orders, emulator screenshots, UiTest interaction and component evidence, functional and side-effect assertions, bounded repair, and human review. Use only after approved Gate 3.

trigger_surface.description: Implement and verify HarmonyOS NEXT pages from frozen Android page contracts and an approved scaffold, using a per-page UI understanding and conversion agent, page-owned work orders, shared capability orders, emulator screenshots, UiTest interaction and component evidence, functional and side-effect assertions, bounded repair, and human review. Use only after approved Gate 3.
should_trigger: Implement approved Android Page-ID contracts as ArkTS pages after Gate 3.

steps: Verify current machine and human approval for Gate 3 and freeze Phase 2 inputs plus the accepted scaffold.
Issue one PAGE_WORK_ORDER for each Page-ID and separate CAPABILITY_WORK_ORDER records for shared native capabilities.
Assign one UI_UNDERSTANDING_AND_CONVERSION_AGENT per Page-ID; it consumes only that page's frozen Phase 2 JSON, CSV, and evidence, writes an arkts-page-plan, then converts that plan to ArkTS.
Forbid cross-page implementation reuse, component or state deletion, transition deletion, and carrier changes unless a named human-approved deviation exists.

Verify the final HAP with emulator screenshots, UiTest automated interactions and component queries, functional assertions, side-effect assertions, test identifiers or component snapshots, and build evidence.
Route mismatches through bounded repair, recompute the machine gate, then stop at WAITING_HUMAN_REVIEW.
decision_points: Contradictory frozen Android facts return to Phase 2.
Shared native behavior uses a capability order but page ownership remains separate.
Build success alone never proves UI or functional parity.
failure_modes: A page is simplified, merged, omitted, or changes carrier.
One agent implements several pages from memory instead of page-scoped evidence.
A model declares parity without screenshot, interaction, assertion, component, build, and side-effect evidence.
